item.title: Berkley crews working to fix broken water mains amid warmer weather
item.description: Much of southeast Michigan is getting a welcomed break from the harsh winter weather, with some parts of metro Detroit seeing temperatures in the 50s on Monday.But unfortunately, the warmer weather often leads to water main breaks.Taking the good with the bad, water main breaks can be caused by fluctuating temperatures and aging infrastructure. Work crews were out early Monday morning repairing a water main break on Tyler in Berkley.City officials informed residents through a social media post.
